# Checkbox

A native checkbox under an 18px drawn box. Ticking fills the box in 133ms, then the tick draws as a stroke over 300ms.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/checkbox)

## Usage

```tsx
<Checkbox checked={news} onChange={event => setNews(event.target.checked)}>
  Email me with news and offers
</Checkbox>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The label text. |
| `…input` | `InputHTMLAttributes` | checked, onChange, disabled and the rest go to the &lt;input type="checkbox">. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Checkbox.module.css`
- `Checkbox.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
